CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

2. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

3. Solve for x: x + 8 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 20

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

10. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 11

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

15. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

16. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
